read.thesis: Jabil guides FY27 revenue to $44.5B (+24%) and core EPS to $17.55 (+34%) on AI revenue of $22.1B, with net capex held at 1.5-2% of revenue and net inventory days still above target at 64.

utilisation.quote: we're beginning to see our capacity investments drive growth

capex.quote: we continue to expect net capital expenditures of 1.5% to 2% of revenue

triggers.label: FY27 core EPS $17.55 (+34%)
triggers.quote: core diluted earnings per share of $17.55, up about 34%

triggers.label: AI revenue $14.4B → $22.1B
triggers.quote: we expect that to grow to approximately $22.1 billion, up 54%

triggers.label: Net inventory days 64, above 55-60 target
triggers.quote: reducing net inventory days by approximately 4 days sequentially to 64

triggers.label: Capacity +4M sq ft tied to booked orders
triggers.quote: the capacity we're adding is tied to programs already booked

guidance.quote: we expect fiscal 2027 revenue of approximately $44.5 billion, up about 24%
core diluted earnings per share of $17.55, up about 34%
we expect core operating margin of 6.1%, an improvement of 30 basis points
In fiscal 2027, we expect that to grow to approximately $22.1 billion, up 54%
we expect that earnings growth to support another year of strong adjusted free cash flow generation of approximately $1.6 billion
Core diluted earnings per share is estimated to be in the range of $3.80 to $4.20.
we continue to expect net capital expenditures of 1.5% to 2% of revenue

red_flags.label: Net inventory days above target range
red_flags.quote: While net inventory days remain above our target range of 55 to 60 days

red_flags.label: Memory supply tightening
red_flags.quote: tightening supply across many of the diversified end markets that we serve

evasions.quote: at this stage, for FY '27, we haven't built in that much from a physical AI perspective
